stand: Lebanon faces a renewed humanitarian and economic crisis. Hostilities escalated sharply on 2 March 2026 amid wider regional conflict, triggering fresh displacement and infrastructure damage. The Ministry of Public Health has recorded at least 3,884 deaths and 11,856 injuries since, per OCHA. Humanitarian partners estimate 1.4 million people need assistance and are seeking US$331.5 million through August 2026. The IPC projects 1.24 million people in acute food insecurity, concentrated in the south. The WFP-led Logistics & Telecommunications Cluster keeps emergency communications running despite access constraints.
